survey for columbarium wall the parish pastoral council, along with the

and the graveyard committees are exploring whether there is sufficient interest in installing columbarium walls in burrane graveyard and knockerra graveyard. a columbarium wall is a permanent, freestanding structure. each wall contains recessed compartments called niches (instead of a plot), designed to respectfully hold 2+ cremation urns. many parishes install them to provide families with a dignified, long-term resting place for loved ones who choose cremation and as an alternative to burial. survey can be accessed by below link or qr code. it will be available on facebook page and social media as well as paper copies will be available at the back of the churches from this weekend.

blessing of graves in kilmaley cemetery on sun 1st nov at 12noon . twenty-ninth sunday in ordinary time mission sunday this year marks the 100th world mission day, with pope leo xiv choosing the theme “one in christ, united in mission.” he encourages christians to renew their missionary spirit and share god’s love with everyone. our christian life begins with a deep friendship with jesus. by remaining united with christ, we become united with one another, creating families and parish communities built on love, forgiveness and peace. our actions should reflect the gospel and proclaim jesus christ rather than ourselves. unity is an essential part of our mission. when christians support, forgive and care for one another, they become witnesses to god’s love. every baptized person is called to be a missionary, not necessarily by travelling abroad, but through everyday life at home, work, in the parish and within the wider community. love is at the heart of mission. inspired by saint francis of assisi and saint thérèse, we are called to love jesus and help others discover his love. through prayer, kindness, generosity and care for those in need, we can make christ known and loved throughout the world. the annual mission collection is being taken up today. annual mass of remembrance kilmaley church on sat 31st oct at 7.30pm we hope this will be a special occasion for family and
